en.wa_text: Hi, I'd like information about {name}'s services.

hero.title: Your finances in order. Your taxes, on time.
hero.subtitle: We prepare returns, keep your business books, and help you pay what's fair, with no penalties or surprises.

items.title: Tax returns
items.text: Puerto Rico and federal returns for individuals, self-employed and corporations.

items.title: IVU and SURI
items.text: Monthly sales tax filings and SURI account management.

items.title: Payroll
items.text: Payroll, withholding, 499R-2/W-2 forms and quarterly returns.

items.title: Bookkeeping
items.text: Monthly financial statements so you know how your business is doing.

items.title: Incorporations
items.text: Corporation and LLC registration, municipal licenses and permits.

items.title: Act 60 and decrees
items.text: Decree compliance and annual reports for resident investors.

items.title: Meeting
items.text: We review your situation and the documents you have.

items.title: Proposal
items.text: A fixed price in writing, no hidden fees.

items.title: Clean-up
items.text: We catch up anything late and set up a simple system.

items.title: Ongoing
items.text: Deadlines, reminders and answers when you need them.

about.title: An accountant who explains your numbers
about.text: At {name} we don't just file: we explain what you're paying and why, and remind you before every deadline. We serve individuals, small businesses and professionals in {municipio} and across the island.

items.q: What documents do I need for my return?
items.a: Forms 499R-2/W-2, 480.6, dependent information and deductible expenses. We'll send you a full checklist.

items.q: I'm behind on my taxes. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. We'll help you catch up with Hacienda and the IRS and negotiate payment plans if needed.

items.q: Do you work with small businesses?
items.a: Yes, most of our clients are small businesses and self-employed professionals.

cta.title: Don't wait for the deadline
cta.text: Book a meeting and leave with a clear plan.

contact.text: Message us, call, or set up a video meeting.
